info.title: Webmania Emissor Fiscal API2 — dce known field groups draft
info.description: Concrete typed request/response groups for dce. Conditional, provider and runtime catalogs are not exhaustively modeled; no full-product or fiscal approval claim.

200.description: Business response. HTTP200 is not proof of fiscal approval; inspect status and a possible error field.

default.description: Authentication, subscription, fiscal validation or provider error. Do not retry uncertain fiscal operations.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Existing company-owned fiscal UUID or access key as documented; preserve as a string.

200.description: Business response. HTTP200 is not proof of fiscal approval; inspect status and a possible error field.

default.description: Authentication, subscription, fiscal validation or provider error. Do not retry uncertain fiscal operations.

x-operation-effects.notes: Consultations may refresh provider state. Use stable existing documents and review the operation branch before treating a consultation as read-only.

IssuerBearer.description: Existing company API2 Bearer token with issue capability and the required product subscription. Separate from Monitor fdmanagement tokens, API1 four headers and X-Token; never fall back.

EmitterError.description: The API can return a functional error in HTTP 200. A present error property is always failure. Redact all service credentials and preserve HTTP status.

NfseParameterRequirements.description: Map from dotted public field paths to requirement labels, including obrigatorio,obrigatorio_pf,obrigatorio_pj,opcional. Additional future labels/fields are preserved; not all providers return this map.

NfseProviderStatus.description: Company/provider capabilities. Successful status=true does not authorize issuing without checking the returned environment/authentication/model/function support. Error status=false responses are functional errors, not a successful capability lookup.

NfcomServiceStatus.description: The current service always probes the production SEFAZ environment. Operational=true returns HTTP 200; operational=false returns HTTP 503, preserving the body as failure context. A configured A1 certificate and eligible NFCom subscription are required.

log.description: Provider-specific raw fiscal log; preserve structure and additional fields. Never include unredacted credential values in an exception.

NfseFiscalResponse.description: Known individual NFSe, batch RPS and manifestation response fields. Empty fields may be omitted; status values include processing/scheduled/approved/rejected/cancelled variants and are preserved as strings. API transport success is not fiscal approval. Files are URLs; lote_rps carries per-note info_nfse. Provider/error variants are not exhaustively modeled.

anyOf.description: Provider-specific raw fiscal log; preserve structure and additional fields. Never include unredacted credential values in an exception.

NfcomFiscalResponse.description: Fiscal status and URLs for the company-owned NFCom. Additional event/provider details are preserved. Approved and rejected business states can both use HTTP 200.

chave.description: Nacional NFSe access key, exactly 50 characters; a UUID is not accepted.

NfseManifestationRequest.description: Padrão Nacional only, valid certificate required. manifestador 1 tomador / 2 intermediary; evento 1 confirmation / 2 rejection. Rejection requires motivo_rejeicao; reason 9 other requires justification. This creates a fiscal event and is excluded from read-only validation.

log.description: Provider-specific structured fiscal log. Preserve its fields and precision; never put raw credentials into an exception.

CteFiscalResponse.description: CT-e and CT-e OS share this response envelope; modelo distinguishes them. Fiscal rejection can use HTTP200. File URLs may be null/unavailable before authorization; EPEC state does not imply a normal authorization protocol.

log.description: Provider-specific structured fiscal log. Preserve its fields and precision; never put raw credentials into an exception.

MdfeFiscalResponse.description: MDF-e status and file URLs. Keep issuer/transport mode rules separate from CT-e finality values.

log.description: Provider-specific structured fiscal log. Preserve its fields and precision; never put raw credentials into an exception.

DceFiscalResponse.description: Known unwrapped DC-e business response; null fields may be omitted.

log.description: Provider-specific structured fiscal log. Preserve its fields and precision; never put raw credentials into an exception.

FiscalEventResponse.description: Known cancellation/correction/delivery/payment event fields. Not every event returns uuid; event-specific protocol/log additions remain allowed.
